demandMap.note: The recurring anchor: monthly-refreshed targeting intelligence that sits above whoever buys the media. Sold per month, per scope — never bundled one-time.

everything.note: One-time license to every dossier below at the retained rate (40% off the itemized sum). Demand Map subscriptions are separate and recurring.

retainer.label: Promanteia retainer
retainer.blurb: Anchored on the Demand Map subscription: the monthly map IS the retainer, with an annual reading allotment drawn against it at ~40% off list, front-of-queue priority, carved exclusivity on your named device families, and standing recall alerting. Rush readings bill the published ×2.0 Emergency Priority Surcharge.
